bio: This bistro tucked away in a narrow street in Tournon exudes a quiet charm. A couple who are passionate about what they do devise their own meticulous and inspired signature cuisine. One dish on the single set menu changes every day, reflecting their creative freedom. Fresh produce, organic vegetables from Les Îles Féray, spot-on cooking: their dishes demonstrate precision, artistry and flavour. The ideal place for a peaceful lunch, shaded by parasols, in an atmosphere of warmth and authenticity....
